rece_source_pin.algebraic_derivation: In the source: mat1 = r*I + sum_l W_l^T W_l; mat2 = sum_l W_l^T W0_l (both accumulated from zero/r*I, model=working checkpoint supplies W_l, model_copy=M0 supplies W0_l); coefficient = inverse(mat1) @ mat2; adv_embedding = concept_embedding @ coefficient.T. Transposing: adv_embedding^T = coefficient^T^T... = (inv(mat1)@mat2)^T applied... concretely adv_embedding^T = inverse(mat1) @ mat2 @ concept_embedding^T (using mat1 symmetric so inverse(mat1)^T = inverse(mat1)). Writing A=mat1, B=mat2, C=concept_embedding, D=B@C^T, Y=adv_embedding: A @ Y^T = D exactly -- matches the task's stated A, B, D, and AY*^T=D normal-equation form with no discrepancy.
